criteria.primary_metric: leave-one-out decision-bit accuracy on the 22 correction surfaces (decision positions [7,8], 2 bits x 22 turns)
criteria.ridge_lambda_selection: per outer LOO fold: inner LOO over the 21 training rows only; highest inner decision-bit accuracy wins; tie-break larger lambda

control_statistic.window_identity: one fitted probe on 2-d feedback-window one-hot (20.2s window_features)
control_statistic.label_permutation_5_seeds: per-seed MAX over seeds 20261105..20261109; mean is reported for sensitivity only
control_statistic.random_projection_same_dim_same_norm: one fitted probe on a random vector of the same dimension and norm

criteria.strongest_control: max of the four frozen control statistics (20.3a frozen max-per-seed reading, not the 20.2s mean reading)
criteria.sensitivity: report both max-control (binding) and mean-control (20.2s legacy) margins and verdicts; the max-control verdict is binding and must not be switched after reading
criteria.checkpoint_aggregation: all four 20.4c_r2 final checkpoints evaluated independently; the binding verdict uses the STRICTEST (minimum margin); disagreement across checkpoints implies inconclusive

effective_dof_gate.unit: distinct F vectors across the 22 correction surfaces
effective_dof_gate.on_violation: inconclusive; paired bootstrap must resample distinct F vectors, not the 22 rows

decision_rule.representation_has_authority: primary >= pass_accuracy AND margin >= pass_margin AND all four controls present AND effective_dof >= 3 AND all four checkpoints agree; produces a PRICING INPUT only, not pricing approval, not training admission, not a capability claim
decision_rule.representation_axis_closed_for_this_grap: primary < fail_accuracy OR margin < fail_margin, with all controls below the pass gate; range-limited verdict, must not be upgraded to 'impossible'
decision_rule.inconclusive: fail_margin <= margin < pass_margin OR checkpoint disagreement OR effective_dof < 3; report all control values and intervals; no dose change, no threshold change, no automatic training transition
decision_rule.engineering_stop: any control missing / feature card not frozen before reading / checkpoint sha mismatch / criteria_sha256 mismatch / confirm touched / graph identity drift / runner dual hash mismatch
decision_rule.budget_stop: cpu >= cpu_stop_threshold or wall >= wall_cap; do not shrink data and rerun

This pre-registration adopts the frozen 20.3a max reading as binding and records 20.2s as a historical sensitivity anchor. Gate values are unchanged.
criteria.transition_conflict_registration: package 21 section 4 and plan P1 say a negative/inconclusive result transfers to 21.4/P3, but neither 21.4 nor P3 admits 'representation judged negative'. Therefore this package only records the verdict; no automatic training transition.
